ledgerSearch.outcome: No settled decision conflicts with the baseline. CTD-0016 tracks the technological power thesis, and wielding as a developmental capacity is that thesis in its compact form; the baseline states it no more strongly than the shipped text. CTD-0020 is status query and names this closing crescendo. The restored triple negation, not the only attempt, not sufficient on its own, not the answer, moves the passage toward less certainty rather than more, which is worth noting against the assumption that every restoration in this chapter raises the pressure.

findings.summary: A five-sentence call and response about what the moment is not asking was collapsed into one sentence.

evidence.baseline: This is what the present moment is asking of humanity. Not whether intelligence will be developed. It is being developed. Not whether it will be deployed at planetary scale. It is being deployed. The question is whether the species can become, in the time available, capable of wielding what it has built without being broken by it.
evidence.shipped: The present moment asks humanity not whether intelligence will be developed or deployed at planetary scale. It is being developed and deployed. The question is whether the species can become capable, in the time available, of wielding what it has built without being broken by it.

findings.diagnosis: 4.3's retention limb applies: both sides are plausible and the distinction matters, because the two rejected questions are the two the public debate actually asks. The structure is a refusal repeated twice, each time immediately settled by a flat statement of fact, and the flatness is the argument. It is being developed. It is being deployed. Merged into one compound negative and one compound answer, the refusal happens once and the reader is told rather than shown that the question has moved.

findings.summary: An anadiplosis chain of three sentences was broken by pronominalizing its middle term.

evidence.baseline: The wielding is a developmental capacity. The capacity has to be cultivated. The cultivation is the work the book has been describing.
evidence.shipped: Wielding is a developmental capacity. It must be cultivated. Its cultivation is the work the book has described.

findings.diagnosis: Each sentence begins with the noun the previous sentence ended on. Wielding to capacity to cultivation, three steps carrying the reader from the title word to the book's subject in twenty-two words. The chain is the reframe the section is named for. Pronominalizing capacity to it breaks the middle link and leaves two sentences about wielding and one about cultivation. 4.20's own instruction applies: if the exact word is right, repeat it.

findings.summary: A triple negation lost its third member, which was the strongest disclaimer in the epilogue.

evidence.baseline: It is not the only attempt, not sufficient on its own, not the answer.
evidence.shipped: It is neither the only attempt nor sufficient on its own.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.4, synthetic symmetry, read onto a triad.
findings.diagnosis: R-REMOVE-BURDEN was not met. Not the answer is not a third instance of the same disclaimer, it is a different and larger one: the first two concede scope, the third concedes standing. Nothing else in the epilogue says the book is not the answer, so the material did not survive anywhere. The neither and nor construction also closes the set at two, which is the same completeness signal recorded five times elsewhere in this volume.

findings.summary: Three repeated withs and an active and passive contrast were normalized.

evidence.baseline: with intention, with skill, with the responsibility that comes from knowing what the thing can do ... The word does not name a passive relationship. It names an active one, in which the person doing the wielding is changed by what they hold
evidence.shipped: with intention, skill, and the responsibility that comes from knowing what it can do ... The word does not name a passive relationship. It names one in which the wielder is changed by what they hold

findings.diagnosis: The repeated with makes three separate conditions of holding rather than one list of attributes, which matters because the third is of a different order from the first two. Dropping active from names an active one also removes half of a stated contrast and leaves passive unanswered. And the person doing the wielding was chosen over the wielder for a reason the paragraph makes explicit two sentences later: the person is changed by what they hold, so the phrase has to keep the person in it.

regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. F3 is the finding worth carrying: the deletion of not the answer is the only place in Chapter Twelve where the pass removed a disclaimer rather than a commitment, and it happened because the disclaimer was the third member of a triad and triads attract catalog 4.4. A pattern rule fired on the shape of the sentence without asking what the third item said. That is the failure mode R-CATALOG-LIMBS exists to prevent, and it is the mirror image of R-CAUTIOUS-HALF rather than a counterexample to it: in both cases the surviving text is the one that commits the book to less.
